sections.content: mindig (always) and gyakran (often) are frequency adverbs. In a simple sentence they sit right before the verb: Mindig reggel tanulok. (I always study in the morning.) Gyakran sportolok. (I often do sports.)

items.english: I always study in the morning.

sections.content: mindig and gyakran can also open the sentence, exactly where you'd expect an adverb of frequency in English — this is one word-order rule that rarely trips learners up.
